_readme: Golden set for the inbound pipeline. Offline: tests/decision-golden.test.ts checks the parts that need no model (filter, gate parsing, decision validation, commerce-claim guard, prompt delimiting). Live: `node --experimental-strip-types scripts/eval-decisions.ts` runs the real decision model against every case with `expect` and reports where it deviates. Add a case for every mistake you see in production; never add a real customer's text.
